name: Semantica
description:
Semantica AI is an analytics and growth platform for AI search and LLMs (Generative Engine Optimization / GEO / AI-SEO). It measures how often and how favorably your brand is mentioned in AI-generated answers across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode/Overviews, YandexGPT, DeepSeek, Grok, and GigaChat — and helps you grow that visibility for the topics and prompts you care about.

This connector gives Claude direct, structured access to your Semantica data:
• Projects, scans, and brand-visibility metrics over time
• Competitor tracking, sentiment, and share-of-voice
• Cited pages and source domains behind AI answers
• Zero-click ranking of your brand vs. competitors inside AI responses
• Change drivers between scans

It also bundles research tools: Yandex Wordstat and Google Trends demand data, AI-crawler accessibility checks (Agent Ready), and product-feed audits (AI Commerce).

Ask questions like "How did my brand's AI visibility change in the last scan and what drove it?" or "Which competitors are winning in Perplexity for my topics?" and get answers backed by real scan data instead of guesswork.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Semantica to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Semantica to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.ai-semantica.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Semantica MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Semantica lists 61 MCP tools, including add_project_competitor, add_publication, agent_ready_check, agent_ready_get_check, agent_ready_history, analyze_competitor_sentiment, append_project_topics_prompts, delete_publication, get_client_projects, get_client_scans, get_mentioned_pages, and get_mentioned_pages_cited_sites.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Semantica?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Semantica in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Semantica requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Semantica is developed by Semantica AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
